settings.title: Settings
settings.providerHelp: Each provider keeps its own key, model and voice, so you can compare them.
settings.apiKeyHelp: Stored encrypted on the server and never sent back to the browser.
settings.modelHelp.openrouter: Lists the OpenRouter models that produce audio.
settings.modelHelp.elevenlabs: eleven_multilingual_v2 handles Spanish well; the turbo/flash models are cheaper and faster.
settings.modelPriceHelp: Price: {price} tokens of text sent. A typical novel is around half a million.
settings.modelsError: Could not load the model list. You can type the id manually.
settings.modelsNeedKey: Add the API key to see this account's models and voices.
settings.voiceInferred: OpenRouter publishes no voices for this model: this list is guessed from the id and may be wrong.
settings.voiceUnknown: the model's voice id, e.g. af_bella
settings.testText: Hi, this is how your book will sound.
settings.testOk: Done. If you heard nothing, check your volume.
settings.readingLangHelp: Controls sentence splitting and which voice is picked.
settings.deviceVoiceHelp: These come from the operating system and differ on every device. The choice is saved here only.
settings.deviceVoiceNone: This device has no voices for the reading language.
settings.browserVoiceHelp: Free and works offline, but sounds worse than the AI voices.
settings.clearCache: Clear audio cached on this device
settings.installHelp: Add it to your home screen to use it like a native app.
